usage: agentbreeder invoke [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json] [--candidate]
                           [--customer ID] [--session ID] [--stack DIR]
                           [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                           NAME MESSAGE

positional arguments:
  NAME                  Agent name from agent.yaml
  MESSAGE               The message, or - to read stdin

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --candidate           Call NAME-candidate (the release candidate) instead of
                        production
  --customer ID         customer_id to send (not authenticated)
  --session ID          session_id to continue (not authenticated)
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        With --stack: the stack environment
